name: LavaLending UniV3Wrapper one-sided unclaimed-fee inflation
summary: LiquidityProviderBase._limitFees() caps a Uniswap V3 position's pending fees only when BOTH token fee amounts exceed their max-APR budget (`if (totalFees0 > max0 && totalFees1 > max1)`), so fees accrued in a single token are returned uncapped. UniV3Wrapper.getAssetsBasedOnPrice() adds those uncapped fees to the oracle-priced fair reserves, and Lava's WrapperOracle divides that sum by totalSupply to price the USDC/USDC.e wrapper LP token. The attacker minted a dust LP position, drove one-directional swaps through the 0x8e295789 USDC/USDC.e pool to accrue ~100k of token0-only fees against a 0.000999-share supply, and borrowed the Lava market out against the inflated collateral. The Chainlink-derived sqrtPriceX96 in WrapperOracle defends only the getAmountsForLiquidity() leg; the unclaimed-fee addend bypasses it entirely.
notes: The ERC-1967 wrapper proxy emitted exactly two Upgraded events before the exploit: one at creation to 0xedc9c9bbc6308f02f0500b50a8c318e2e46d0824 and this one, the last pre-exploit change, to the defect-bearing UniV3Wrapper implementation 0xf6b3c18023c1e387a673b3101c73fc985290fbd9.

Components are exact ERC-20 Transfer nettings from the single anchor receipt, summed over the depleted victim addresses: the Lava aToken reserves aUSDC 0x16cb622cae7ad9fd2b0780b2026ed301414781fe, aUSDC.e 0x16cba9a6a9bb38e339d4250da0afd919c6bdbdfe, aUSDT 0x8da6bc74b2534030cd38c996c395b914990fa684, aWETH 0xec9b99c8262b72d846f0f80fce76af7d3c7c6af6 and awstETH 0xcb1332663a39f238bcd1cc7621e3e24a50251b94, plus the wrapper's own Uniswap V3 position in pool 0x8e295789c9465487074a65b1ae9ce0351172393f (25,644.648649 USDC and 49,038.308971 USDC.e) and the wrapper contract balance (1.278268 USDC), which the attacker redeemed with the LP shares he borrowed uncollateralised. Every one of the five reserves was drained to exactly zero. The 923.684256 USDC and 1,350.185377 USDC.e retained by the Uniswap V3 flash pools are financing fees paid out of the stolen funds and are therefore included in gross depletion rather than netted off; the attacker's own end balances were 77,477.425666 USDC, 96,215.533581 USDC.e, 60,349.016947 USDT, 8.525476552027716376 wstETH and 20.332763573538003060 ETH after gas. Flash-loan principals from Balancer, Aave V3 and the Uniswap V3 pools were repaid inside the transaction and are not counted. Stables are valued at par; WETH uses the DefiLlama ETH price and wstETH the DefiLlama mainnet wstETH price at the incident timestamp, both transferred in kind rather than sold, so no price impact applies.
